598:t_5:73.en:
$$ガエル$$
「$$サイアム$$...! I'll carry you to a safe place!」

598:t_5:74.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Could you take $$オードリー$$ too?」

598:t_5:76.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...You were at the mansion when I received $$ユニコーン$$ from my father, weren't you?」

598:t_5:77.en:
$$ガエル$$
「Yes. At that time I was in the service of $$カーディアス$$.」

598:t_5:78.en:
$$ガエル$$
「$$バナージ$$... Your father had a dream. A dream of building a new world in a future where the Box has been opened.」

598:t_5:79.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Father's dream... So that's what was entrusted to me.」

598:t_5:80.en:
$$ガエル$$
「But coming this far was your own will. It is no curse.」

598:t_5:81.en:
$$ガエル$$
「So advance without hesitation. You are... your father's dream itself.」

598:t_5:84.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm heading out, $$オードリー$$. I'm... $c.」

598:t_6:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What am I... looking at...」

598:t_6:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is where it all began. As I thought, you can see it too.」

598:t_6:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then let us go together... to the end of time in this universe, $$バナージ$$!」

598:t_6:12.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A perfect void, with no light, where even time has stopped flowing... This is the end of the world... the world that awaits at the end of time...」

598:t_6:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is this... the future of despair...?」

598:t_6:14.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Who knows... But I certainly tasted despair.」

598:t_6:15.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Humanity, unchanged even when shown the light of the human heart... But that is not their own fault...」

598:t_6:16.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「In the end, humans cannot become gods, and they cannot surpass God.」

598:t_6:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Only humans have God... The power to surpass the present... the God within called possibility...!」

598:t_6:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You can say that because you don't know the truth.」

598:t_6:20.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If you learned the truth of the Box, you would be unable to bear its weight and sink into despair.」

598:t_6:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The truth of the Box... the doctrine of $$クロノ$$...」

598:t_6:22.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「No matter how hard humans struggle, the ending does not change...」

598:t_6:23.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You must know it too. Hope and possibility are just a fleeting dream humans see at the entrance to this void... An illusion that does not even comfort.」

598:t_6:24.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It leads humans astray and even breeds needless conflict. The one who knows this truth is the one who is truly chosen.」

598:t_6:26.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「We should not raise excessive hopes for life that merely exists and fades away...」

598:t_6:29.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$アムロ$$! Why are you here!?」

598:t_6:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Someday, humanity will even master time... I'm here because I believe that someday will come, too.」

598:t_6:31.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You mean when $$ララァ$$ died...!」

598:t_6:32.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There is warmth inside you, too!」

598:t_6:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「No matter how deep the darkness, we will never lose sight of tomorrow.」

598:t_6:36.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Laugh at us for fools if you want. But we believe.」

598:t_6:37.en:
$$刹那$$
「The future will come... No, I will carve it out with my own hands.」

598:t_6:38.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We don't have time to despair!」

598:t_6:39.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Time moves toward the future. As long as we wish it to.」

598:t_6:40.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So this is the civilization of fire... What humans create for themselves gives humans new power...」

598:t_6:41.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It is the power to believe in hope together with someone...」

598:t_6:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You must know that, too.」

598:t_6:44.en:
$$シャア$$
「But you gave in to despair.」

598:t_6:46.en:
$$シャア$$
「The $$シャア・アズナブル$$ inside you despaired, leapt across space-time through the $$新世時空震動$$, and entered you, the vessel.」

598:t_6:47.en:
$$シャア$$
「You were too pure, $$フロンタル$$. You worried over the world with deadly earnestness, rushed to find an answer, and tried to carry the world alone.」

598:t_6:48.en:
$$シャア$$
「...Forgive me. By rights, I was the one who should have understood you.」

598:t_6:49.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「An apology now, $$シャア$$!」

598:t_6:50.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But you will all come to know it in time! Warmth... a warm light... No matter how much of this piles up, nothing...!」

598:t_6:52.en:
???
「This warmth is what will warm the universe, isn't it?」

598:t_6:55.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Time to bow out... is it...」

598:t_6:58.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...」

598:t_6:59.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$バナージ$$... the one guided by $$ガンダム$$... And $$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

598:t_6:60.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Perhaps you two can find a rainbow beyond the despair I could not overcome.」

598:t_6:62.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And then, find the future that lies beyond even that.」

598:t_6:63.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I leave it to you... whatever you... think must be done...」

598:t_7:4.en:
$$サイアム$$
「...I wonder what kind of future this will bring...」

598:t_7:6.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Nothing may change... Words are only words. Even the law can be interpreted any way to suit people's convenience.」

598:t_7:7.en:
$$サイアム$$
「With the $$新地球皇国$$ in existence, this may well turn out to be a meaningless folly.」

598:t_7:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even so... Even so, both $$バナージ$$ and $c will do what they think must be done.」

598:t_7:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Just like the people who, on the day humanity decided to live in the new world of space, carved their heartfelt goodwill into this monument.」

598:t_7:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Just like you, who have kept guarding the Box to pass that goodwill down to the present.」

598:t_7:11.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That one... has found a fine partner...」
